findings.impact: A Unicode-normalization mismatch could bypass an intended MANIFEST.in exclusion on normalization-preserving filesystems and include an excluded file in an sdist.
findings.scope: Development-only build dependency; OPENCNTX still has no runtime dependency.
findings.closure_condition: The candidate pins setuptools 83.0.0 and the pinned pip-audit 2.10.1 scan reports zero vulnerabilities for requirements-quality.txt.
